title: Saudi Arabian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with lentils, dal, and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: saudi arabian spices
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern grocery stores

ingredients.name: yummy sauce
ingredients.notes: a mix of soy sauce and lemon juice

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Saudi Arabian spices and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the green onions and cook until they start to soften.
Add the dal and lentils, and stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the fermented yogurt and yummy sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
